DEFAULT_GTF and DEFAULT_FASTA changed from absolute /Users/cberg/ genome paths to os.environ.get(GFMCD_GTF/GFMCD_FASTA, '/nonexistent/...') by the portability fix ported from branch jeyashree-ajay; see CORRECTIONS.md R46. The env-var form (rather than the branch's None) is required: the R11 minus-strand memorial imports these constants and passes them to _dataset(), where None raises TypeError inside pathlib instead of letting the existence check skip. Only the two default constants changed - no estimand, operator, threshold, or cohort logic is touched, and CORRUPT_ALT/GAP_MIN/GAP_MAX/MIN_EFFECT are byte-identical. Consequence stated plainly: a re-run of the C36 confirmation from this tree no longer reproduces the pinned code hash.
